question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**between**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how planning helps in time management.
 
• The word to fill the blank should show the relationship between "work" and "personal life."
 
• "Between" is the correct preposition to show a relationship or balance involving two distinct things (work and personal life).
 
• The other options do not accurately convey the intended relationship.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Effective time management is (1) crucial__ for success. By prioritising tasks, individuals can enhance (2)__**productivity**__ and reduce stress. Planning allows for a balance (3)__**between **__work and personal life. Studies show that those who manage their time (4) _____are more likely to achieve their goals. It is a skill (5)____positively impacts both professional and personal aspects of life.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **With** (के साथ): "With" implies accompaniment, not a balance between two separate entities.
 
• **Around** (चारों ओर): "Around" indicates a surrounding position, which doesn't fit the context of balancing work and life.
 
• **Beyond** (परे): "Beyond" suggests something is outside the limits, not a balance between two things.
